name: A different summer
source:
A Different Summer puts ourselves in the shoes of a student, with bad grades, who has been punished during the summer to work on a kind of farm under the orders of a friend of his father. In that place he will meet different women who will make his stay very very pleasant, turning, not without difficulties and entanglements, our protagonist into the object of desire of the women present there.

Misunderstandings, deceptions, revenge and above all a lot of sex and lust will be the daily life of that place, which boasted of being boring, will become a paradise of mature women and lust.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《一个不同的夏天》让我们站在一个成绩不好的学生的角度，他在暑假期间受到惩罚，在他父亲的朋友的命令下在一个农场工作。在那个地方，他会遇到不同的女人，她们会让他的逗留非常愉快，不无困难和纠葛，将我们的主角变成那里的女人渴望的对象。

误解、欺骗、报复，尤其是大量的性和情欲，将成为那个自诩无聊的地方的日常生活，将成为成熟女性和情欲的天堂。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698340/]Steam[/url]]
